description: This file defines the MdcEntry interface, which encapsulates a diagnostic context key-value pair for logging purposes within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to create instances and retrieve the key and value of a diagnostic context entry.

classes.name: MdcEntry
classes.description: An interface representing a key-value pair used for diagnostic context logging, intended to be used with the MDC feature of logback, for associating contextual information with logs.

methods.name: of
methods.description: A static factory method that creates an MdcEntry instance with a specified key and optional value.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key identifying the diagnostic context.

methods.name: getValueOrNull
methods.description: Returns the diagnostic context value or null if none is set.
